EGG AZO decoder

Probability models, arithmetic decoder and tables ported to C++ from:
https://github.com/akolman/EggDotNet/tree/78b64f54026a8687dac1cdd4c86eb5fe5abf04ae/src/EggDotNet/Compression/AZO
Commit: 78b64f54026a8687dac1cdd4c86eb5fe5abf04ae
License: MIT; original notice retained in LICENSE.EggDotNet.txt.
Exact reference sources and per-file hashes:
tests/fixtures/archives/egg/EggDotNet-reference-source.tar.gz and manifest.json

One changes: C++ port with exact-read/write callbacks, bounded zero padding,
strict sizes/indices/match distances, memory accounting before allocation and
cancellation checkpoints. AZO framing has no checksum; the enclosing EGG reader
must check each decoded block's CRC, size and complete packed consumption.

Per-block x86 address filter follows the CC0 1.0 descriptive pseudocode A.12:
https://github.com/alkegi/docs/blob/36230c34d3056604cc63519e9855a79e894496b7/egg.md
Git blob: 748a5940cc4e07f03867bb1dc09da86e586ed367
This document is only a secondary description. Parent-path semantics and the
private-version constant disagree with real files/reference code elsewhere;
One validates actual fixtures rather than trusting those descriptions.

This implementation unit is tested independently. It does not by itself add
an EGG product entry point. The test-only .NET oracle is not a runtime dependency.
